versions.changelog: Pure x402 pay-per-call. Removed registration and trial credits.

Stock Bloc skill v1.1.0 introduces agent self-registration and per-call payments:

- Agents can now self-register to receive a permanent API key with 100 free trial credits.
- Added per-call pricing with x402 payment (USDC on Base) to access real-time market data, quant signals, SEC filings, research memos, and more.
- Detailed price catalog for all endpoints is now included.
- Cost comparison section to help users evaluate savings versus subscription-based data providers.
- Discovery links for service introspection are provided.
